scripts.agent:sync: node scripts/syncVersion.js && NO_PACK=1 node scripts/buildPkg.js && node scripts/syncLocalAgent.mjs
scripts.agent:publish: npm run agent:build && cd agent && npm publish
scripts.pc:build: npm run agent:build && node scripts/syncLocalAgent.mjs && npx --prefix desktop tauri build --bundles dmg --no-sign && cp desktop/src-tauri/target/release/bundle/dmg/*.dmg desktop/release/macos/
scripts.pc:build:dev: NREMOTE_WORKER_URL=https://dev.9remote.cc npm run agent:build && node scripts/syncLocalAgent.mjs && npx --prefix desktop tauri build --bundles dmg --no-sign && cp desktop/src-tauri/target/release/bundle/dmg/*.dmg desktop/release/macos/
scripts.docs:deploy: npm run build --workspace=gitbook && cd gitbook && npx wrangler pages deploy out --project-name=9remote-docs
scripts._pc:tauri: NINEREMOTE_ENV=development npm run tauri dev --prefix desktop
